title: Supplementary Table S6. Country-level associations and conventional weighted regression estimates.
description: Prespecified Spearman correlations between national research-capacity indicators and country-level IRIS outcomes, together with bootstrap confidence intervals, unadjusted and Holm-adjusted P values, and conventional weighted linear regression estimates based on model-derived standard errors.
notes: 1. Correlation confidence intervals were estimated using 10,000 country-level bootstrap resamples. | 2. The four correlation P values were treated as one family and adjusted using the Holm procedure. | 3. The weighted regression used the number of represented IRIS institutions as the country weight and included 59 complete-case countries. | 4. Only conventional model-based standard errors are reported, consistent with the inferential approach retained in the manuscript. | 5. Leave-one-country-out estimates remained negative for both research-capacity coefficients.
